headline: A 2016 law renamed a Phoenix, Arizona post office after former congressman Ed Pastor.
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 522 North Central Avenue in Phoenix, Arizona, the "Ed Pastor Post Office." It is a commemorative naming measure and does not change how mail is handled or who can use the building. The official summary describes only the renaming.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 29, 2016.
